article.headline: Marcus Tankersley, Jalyke Gaines-Wyatt help Alcorn State fend off Alabama State 67-65
article.description: — Marcus Tankersley and Jalyke Gaines-Wyatt both scored 13 to help Alcorn State hold off Alabama State 67-65 on Monday night.
article.linkText: Marcus Tankersley, Jalyke Gaines-Wyatt help Alcorn State fend off Alabama State 67-65

categories.description: Alabama State Hornets @ Alcorn State Braves

event.description: Alabama State Hornets @ Alcorn State Braves

keywords: Alabama State Hornets @ Alcorn State Braves
article.story: LORMAN, Miss. -- — Marcus Tankersley and Jalyke Gaines-Wyatt both scored 13 to help Alcorn State hold off Alabama State 67-65 on Monday night. Tankersley added six rebounds for the Braves (2-14, 2-1 Southwestern Athletic Conference). Davian Williams had 11 points. The Hornets (6-11, 2-2) were led by CJ Hines with 13 points. Amarr Knox added 11 points, four assists and two steals. Tyler Mack had eight points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
